page.overview:
Who is Kili Enhanced Great Ape?

The Kili Enhanced Great Ape is a character in Dragon Ball Online.

Due to the game shutting down prematurely, his role in the game is unknown, though his status as the strongest enemy in the game implied he may have been part of the major plot line concerning Towa's attempt at obtaining Goku's DNA.

;Video games He is one of the most powerful enemies from the game. He is stronger than Cell-X, Gamelan, Week, the White Space Cat and even the Black Space Cat who is the final boss from the Capsule Corporation Battle Dungeon.

The Kili Enhanced Great Ape would have appeared permanently as a Great Ape. Like other Great Apes under Time Breaker Mind Control, the Kili Enhanced Great Ape would have had a green Time Breaker mind control gem attached to his forehead. He additionally has a tank attached to his back continuously pumping Kili into his body, making him stronger than other brainwashed Great Apes.
